name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2026-01-05, at wavelengths from 1.05 to 4.30 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
